v5.note: Three filled trades are a small selected sample, not proof of a profitable full-signal strategy.

fundingPilot.scope: Stored accounting-source observations only; no position or earned profit.

findings.name: Native protective-order limits
findings.status: Configured 0.5% is not an enforced exit cap
findings.detail: All six recorded v5 protective plans used market TP/SL orders. In both filled take-profit orders, the executable limit widened from about 0.5% to 10% beyond the trigger, consistent with venue market-trigger semantics. Actual fills were favorable in those two examples; this is not a claim of realized 10% slippage. Retained stop orders have no fills, and older order history is incomplete. Stop costs remain unmeasured. Live protection and risk are unchanged; switching to stop-limit orders can leave a position unfilled during a gap.

findings.name: Aggressive 30-market test
findings.detail: The 30-entry retrospective price simulation returned -45.27% at 20% modeled stop risk and -79.12% at 40%, using 83 bp costs and excluding funding. These are hypothetical returns, not actual losses or a clean out-of-sample test. Live risk is unchanged.

findings.name: Regime and funding filters
findings.detail: Three fixed single filters were tested on all 78 original candidates. Funding at least twice its prior-day median produced 2.19% across 23 hypothetical entries at 20% modeled risk and 83 bp costs, but -7.57% in the later period and -34.02% with doubled costs. Funding cash is excluded; this is retrospective, not clean holdout evidence. No live promotion.

findings.name: Earlier-history funding replication
findings.status: Large drawdowns; no basis to scale risk
findings.detail: The unchanged funding filter produced 65 hypothetical entries from January 16 to July 10: 22.15% at 29 bp modeled costs, with 64.79% maximum closed-equity drawdown; -45.14% at 83 bp costs. All 30 markets remain included; the earlier interval is unscored because XMR funding history is incomplete. Funding cash is excluded. This is retrospective, not a clean holdout; 20% modeled risk is not a guaranteed loss cap. No live promotion.

findings.name: Measured ZEC trading fees
findings.status: Fees verified; total execution cost unknown
findings.detail: The three completed trades contain 12 native fills and $2.710233 in fees: 8.94 bp round trip, weighted by entry notional. There were zero native stop-loss exits. Fees do not establish all-in execution costs or future stop slippage, so neither the 29 nor 83 bp modeled allowance has been replaced. Actual net P&L remains +$41.34; backtest gains are not credited as earned profit. Live risk is unchanged.

findings.name: ZEC execution
findings.detail: The locally generated API wallet was approved September 5. The IOC rounding repair remains offline and is not deployed.

findings.name: Missed ZEC entries
findings.detail: All seven nearby August 29 book samples covered the original size at the offline corrected limit, but its six-hour minute-mark sample showed no target crossing. September 4 daily marks remain missing. Displayed depth and sampled marks do not prove actual fills or native exits; missed trades receive no profit credit.

findings.name: Swing / order-book ideas
findings.detail: The frozen swing holdout and impact-skew tests were negative after costs. No risk increase or live promotion.

findings.name: Cross-DEX SNDK
findings.detail: All 18 captured matched-size quote calculations were negative after modeled round-trip fees. No trade activated.

findings.name: New-listing readiness
findings.detail: A future-only 72-hour observer was installed September 5. It does not place orders or establish profitability.

findings.name: Legacy research publishers
findings.detail: Six failed research/publishing retry loops were stopped September 5. Their historical evidence is preserved below; they are not represented as healthy live systems.
